content.text: {"results":[{"id":"haru-4b-full-duplex-voice-engineering","title":"Haru 4B：全双工语音开源了，怎样接进真实对话？","titleEn":"Haru 4B: Engineering Open Full-Duplex Voice","description":"Haru 4B 是 higurashi 开源的全双工语音基座模型，支持边听边说。本文核验 Apache 2.0 代码与权重、四千万小时训练数据声明及七点五赫兹连续音频架构，拆解官方六十五毫秒延迟的测量边界，给出 Mac 与 NVIDIA 部署入口、参考音色和音频队列的接入要点，并区分本地测试与尚未复现的真实通话表现。","descriptionEn":"Audit Haru 4B's open full-duplex voice stack, latency framing, Mac and GPU setup, reference voices, and the limits of our local code checks before deployment.","pubDate":"2026-11-14T00:00:00.000Z","updatedDate":"2026-11-14T00:00:00.000Z","tags":["Haru","Full-Duplex","Speech AI","MLX","Open Source"],"category":"Tech-News","url":"/blog/haru-4b-full-duplex-voice-engineering/"},{"id":"jev-interaction-full-duplex-voice-decisions","title":"Jev-Interaction：把全双工语音的接话与让话写成决策","titleEn":"Jev-Interaction: Explicit Decisions for Full-Duplex Voice","description":"Jev-Interaction 把语音助手何时接话、等待、应声和让话拆成可修改的自然语言决策，再以概率和策略驱动交互。本文核对 Apache-2.0 开源框架、外部 Jev 与语音服务依赖、任务配置和事件链路，实跑十项模拟测试，并解释作者基准、评测脚本调参与实际引擎之间的边界，给出从本地演示到产品验证的工程使用路线。","descriptionEn":"Explore Jev-Interaction's explicit turn-taking decisions, external API dependencies, task profiles, replay workflow, and limits of ten local mock-based tests.","pubDate":"2026-11-11T00:00:00.000Z","updatedDate":"2026-11-11T00:00:00.000Z","tags":["Jev-Interaction","语音智能体","全双工","开源框架","工程实践"],"category":"Tech-News","url":"/blog/jev-interaction-full-duplex-voice-decisions/"}]}
